scenes.viewerPurpose: Contrast extraterrestrial ambition with unmet shelter on Earth; Name the book's inquiry into technological purpose
scenes.composition: Place imagined robotic shelter-building on Mars beside people awaiting secure homes on Earth. Return attention to the residents on Earth while the distant ambition remains a comparison.

scenes.title: The garden and its gate
scenes.viewerPurpose: Root paradise in familiar vulnerabilities; Make the garden boundary both shelter and control
scenes.composition: Show water, shade and shelter in an old garden plan as answers to ordinary needs. Hold the garden gate between the protected space and the person controlling entry.

scenes.title: What abundance makes possible
scenes.viewerPurpose: Connect inherited dreams with present technical capacity; Ask how productivity becomes reliable life conditions
scenes.composition: Bring a local robot, repairable infrastructure and damaged land into one practical worksite. Keep a resident beside the proposed improvement and the conditions needed to rely on it.

scenes.title: Turn the mirror toward Earth
scenes.viewerPurpose: Keep progress's promises open to philosophical scrutiny; Return paradise to the Earth still waiting for repair
scenes.composition: Compare the distant construction promise with an unfinished repair close to home. End on the Earth-side worksite, leaving its priorities visibly open to choice.
